horizon_personal_auto_underwriting_guide.question: When can an underwriter record a deductible review for a High band policy?
horizon_personal_auto_underwriting_guide.expected_fact: Only when safe-driving coaching was offered at least 60 days before renewal and declined or not completed, and the renewal date is at least the state notice period away (UW-PA-2026 Section 4.2)

horizon_personal_auto_underwriting_guide.question: What triggers a Human Renewal Review?
horizon_personal_auto_underwriting_guide.expected_fact: Critical band, 2 or more prior claims in 36 months, or prior incurred losses above $15,000 in 36 months (Section 4.3)

horizon_personal_auto_underwriting_guide.question: Which override category applies when a state notice period prevents the recommended action?
What collision premium credit does a $1,000 deductible give?
horizon_personal_auto_underwriting_guide.expected_fact: 18% of the collision premium, which is 38% of the annual premium; $126 on a $1,840 premium (Section 7)

vectordrive_safe_driving_program_terms.p.question: What counts as completing safe-driving coaching?
vectordrive_safe_driving_program_terms.p.expected_fact: All assigned sessions within 60 days and a 30% or greater drop in the targeted event count over the next 60 days (VD-SDP-2026 Section 3.1)

vectordrive_safe_driving_program_terms.p.question: Which coaching module is mandatory for heavy phone distraction?
vectordrive_safe_driving_program_terms.p.expected_fact: Focused Driving, when phone-distraction events exceed 10 in 90 days (Section 2.3)

vectordrive_safe_driving_program_terms.p.question: What is the completion credit and its cap?
vectordrive_safe_driving_program_terms.p.expected_fact: 5% of annual premium at next renewal, capped at $150 per term, once every 24 months (Section 4)

west_region_notice_requirements.pdf.question: How many days of notice does California require for a deductible change?
west_region_notice_requirements.pdf.expected_fact: 30 days, notice code NTC-CA-30, plus 5 days if sent by mail only (NTC-WEST-2026 Section 2)

west_region_notice_requirements.pdf.question: What must a deductible change notice not include?
west_region_notice_requirements.pdf.expected_fact: The claim risk probability or risk band, and any prohibited factor from UW-PA-2026 Section 6 (Sections 3 and 4.3)

cross_source.question: Can POL-000004 move to a deductible review at this renewal?
cross_source.expected_fact: Combines policy data (band, renewal date, prior claims) from governed_policy_risk_decisions with UW-PA-2026 Section 4.2 and the state notice period in NTC-WEST-2026; if coaching was not offered 60 days before renewal, record SAFE_DRIVING_COACHING instead
